answer_1.quote: Self-Debias. ... propose a post-hoc debiasing technique that leverages a model's internal knowledge to discourage it from generating biased text.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text continuations to discourage biased outputs

answer_2.quote: We quantify how biased a language model is by measuring how frequently a model prefers the stereotypical sentence in each pair over the anti-stereotypical sentence.
